
'''Tachibana Shrine''' (橘樹神社) refers to several {{ill|Shinto shrine|en|Shinto shrine|qid=Q845945|lt=Shinto shrine}}.

* {{ill|Tachibana Shrine|ja|橘樹神社 (茂原市)|qid=Q11544302}} - Located in {{ill|Mobara|en|Mobara|qid=Q502486|lt=Mobara, Chiba}}, {{ill|Chiba Prefecture|en|Chiba Prefecture|qid=Q80011|lt=Chiba Prefecture}}. Said to have been founded by {{ill|Yamato Takeru|ja|日本武尊|lt=Prince Yamato Takeru|3=ヤマトタケル|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamato Takeru|13=User:Immanuelle/Yamato Takeru|ja_comment=jawiki redirects to ヤマトタケル|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q461258}}. It is an {{ill|Enshrined deity of Engishiki|ja|延喜式神名帳|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|1=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|2=ja|3=延喜式神名帳|4=zh|5=延喜式神名帳|6=simple|7=Engishiki Jinmyōchō|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Enshrined deity of Engishiki|13=User:Immanuelle/Engishiki Jinmyōchō}} listed shrine, recognized as the {{ill|Ninomiya|de|Ninomiya|it|Ninomiya|ja|二宮|ko|니노미야|ru|Ниномия (значения)|uk|Ніномія|qid=Q841389|lt=Second Shrine (Ninomiya)}} of {{ill|Kazusa Province|en|Kazusa Province|qid=Q1055394|lt=Kazusa Province}}, also known as Tachibana Shrine. After the Meiji era, it held the Rank of {{ill|Ken-sha|ja|県社|qid=Q90139226}}{{efn|Ken-sha|WD=Q90139226|lt=Ken-sha|1=modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/village shrine|qq=ja_comment|qid=Q90139226|qq= 近代社格制度|comment=changed title based on wikidata|WD=Q712534}} under the modern shrine Ranking system. It enshrines {{ill|Tachibanahime-no-Mikoto|lt=Tachibanahime-no-Mikoto|lt=Princess Ototachibana|ja|弟橘媛|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Princess Ototachibana}}.

* {{ill|Tachibana Shrine (Yokohama)|ja|橘樹神社 (横浜市)|qid=Q11544301}} - Located in {{ill|Tennōchō, Hodogaya Ward, Yokohama|ja|保土ケ谷区天王町}}, {{ill|Yokohama|en|Yokohama|qid=Q38283|lt=Yokohama}}, {{ill|Kanagawa Prefecture|en|Kanagawa Prefecture|qid=Q127513|lt=Kanagawa Prefecture}}. Also known as "Tennō-sama."

* {{ill|Tachibana Shrine (Kawasaki City)|ja|橘樹神社 (川崎市)}} - Located in {{ill|Shimoguchi, Takatsu Ward, Kawasaki|ja|高津区子母口}}, {{ill|Kawasaki, Kanagawa|en|Kawasaki, Kanagawa|qid=Q164234|lt=Kawasaki}}, Kanagawa Prefecture, in the former {{ill|Tachibana District, Musashi Province|ja|武蔵国橘樹郡}}.

* {{nihongo|'''{{ill|Tachibana Shrine|qid=Q66769241|lt=Tachibana Shrine}}'''|橘夫人厨子|Tachibana-fujin no zushi}},  A non-Shinto shrine found at [[Hōryū-ji]]
